title: Family tag not set for seats built from custom/openai-compatible specs without registry entry

finding.claim: Family tag not set for seats built from custom/openai-compatible specs without registry entry
finding.recommendation: After the loop that searches parsed entries for family, set providers[name]._codereview_family = fam or 'unknown' unconditionally (currently inside a try/except that may skip the assignment if an exception occurs before the tag line). Ensure the tag is always written, even when fam is None, so the CLI's seat metadata reflects the correct family.

refutation.reason: The code does set the family tag unconditionally after the lookup loop, defaulting to "unknown" when no family is found. That covers custom/openai-compatible specs without a registry entry.

probe.summary: Unknown-family fail-closed probe (`probes/unknown_family_probe.py`, result `unknown-family-3d9645200bc5.txt`): two custom seats on the SAME vendor base both tag family 'unknown' at construction; (a) Tech Lead selection rejects a designated unknown seat with the substitution recorded ('family is unknown — independence cannot be shown'), and an all-unknown panel yields NO Tech Lead; (b) a blocking finding raised by an unknown-family seat is marked cross_family='unknown_family' — never multi-family, never confirmed away; (c) verify_record's two_families FAILS on an all-unknown record ('distinct known families: []').
